reason: The patch makes `.small-action` a flex container at app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:263-265, which renders `float: left` on its direct child `.topic-avatar` (topic-post.scss:270, rendered at app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:1) ignored and dead. Note that `.avatar` (topic-post.scss:298) and `button` (topic-post.scss:309) are nested inside the non-flex block `.small-action-desc` (small-action.hbs:2-12), so only `.topic-avatar`'s float is actually dead.
